$comment: Pre-approved commands so an unattended agent can actually verify its own work. Discovered the hard way on 2026-08-25: the Mac Mini worker ran with --permission-mode acceptEdits, which accepts file edits but still gates Bash, so the agent could change code and could not run the typecheck, the build, or git. Its definition of done was unreachable. The allowlist is deliberately narrow: build, test, inspect, and the git verbs needed to make a commit. Nothing that pushes, merges, installs globally, or touches anything outside the repo.
